# Audited PixelFX water subset

Source https://github.com/patch-gg/pixelfx at5294518ce7c72e48b6100a744596e0acf57f2826 (MIT; notices retained). Unmodified selected source files except core/index.js shim, which omits unrelated effects/rig dependencies. Used offline by the atlas generator; no library code in game runtime. No installer, gallery/font assets, dependencies, network or paid service. See docs/pixel-tool-audit.md.
